scope: Decouple Action Arguments from Options, Fix Action Styling, and Eliminate PowerPoint OpenXML Repair Dialog Warnings

tasks.title: Decouple 'action' parameter from options bag
tasks.description: Refactor hyperlink/action method signatures and internal argument normalizers across HyperlinkManager.js and PPTXTemplater.js delegates. Allow users to pass actions directly as standalone arguments, positional parameters, or action string presets (e.g., 'nextSlide', 'previousSlide', 'firstSlide', 'lastSlide', 'endShow', internal slide indices, or custom URI schemes) without requiring them to be wrapped inside options, while maintaining backward compatibility if passed inside options.

tasks.title: Fix OpenXML DrawingML action attribute generation
tasks.description: Ensure that DrawingML action elements (<a:hlinkClick>) correctly map preset actions without requiring manual URI/protocol plumbing. Specifically generate the correct DrawingML/OpenXML action attributes (e.g., action='ppaction://hlinksldjump', 'ppaction://hlinkshowjump?jump=nextslide', etc.) and slide relationship r:id targets when action is passed directly.

tasks.title: Fix styling application on actions & action-linked runs
tasks.description: Fix DrawingML run property (<a:rPr>) generation when styling is applied alongside actions. Ensure that text styles (color, underline, bold, italic, fontSize, etc.) are properly merged and preserved within the run properties alongside the <a:hlinkClick> node rather than being stripped, overwritten, or omitted during action injection.

tasks.title: Diagnose and eliminate PowerPoint repair errors on exported action decks
tasks.description: Investigate and resolve the OpenXML schema violations causing Microsoft PowerPoint to trigger the 'PowerPoint found a problem with content... PowerPoint can attempt to repair the presentation' warning. Ensure that: (1) internal slide jump actions do not create dangling or duplicate relationship IDs in slideN.xml.rels; (2) target slide relationships use the valid OpenXML slide relationship type (http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide) rather than malformed external hyperlink relationships; (3) child element ordering within <a:rPr> strictly conforms to ECMA-376 (e.g., <a:solidFill>, <a:uFill>, <a:hlinkClick> in valid sequence); (4) shape-level <a:hlinkClick> in <p:cNvPr> does not conflict with existing non-visual drawing properties.

tasks.title: Integration test coverage for actions, styling, and schema repair prevention
tasks.description: Create automated integration tests validating: 1) Invoking action links directly without nesting inside options; 2) Applying custom font colors, underlines, and typography styles to action elements and verifying <a:rPr> markup; 3) Verifying package relationship integrity, schema compliance, and ensuring generated presentations open cleanly without repair flags.

tasks.title: Update showcase and documentation
tasks.description: Update showcase scripts (e.g., showcase/hyperlinks_advanced.js), TypeScript definitions (index.d.ts), and documentation to reflect direct action parameter usage, verified styling capabilities, and clean zero-repair exports.
